summary: Boyd Group Services Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC furnishing a press release dated October 15, 2026, announcing that its fiscal 2026 third quarter results will be released on November 11, 2026, before markets open, followed by a conference call at 8:00 a.m. ET hosted by President and CEO Brian Kaner and EVP/CFO Jeff Murray. The release provides dial-in numbers, a webcast link, and a 90-day archive. This is a routine earnings-notice filing, not a special situation; no terms, advisors, or structural mechanics apply. Watch for Q3 results as the next catalyst.
